summary: Backend testing for BirdLens API completed. All 9 pytest cases passed (100% success). Validated: /api/health (has_llm_key=true), /api/birds/catalog returns 8 seed birds with no _id leakage, /api/birds/{id} for known + unknown ids (404), /api/identify/photo with a real Northern Cardinal JPEG (GPT-4o Vision correctly identified 'Northern Cardinal'), empty image_base64 returns 400, /api/chat single-turn + multi-turn context (the model recalled 'Blue Jay' across two calls using the persisted session_id from MongoDB chat_messages), empty chat message returns 400, and /api/xenocanto?species=Northern+Cardinal returns 200 with empty recordings array (graceful degradation since XENO_CANTO_KEY is intentionally unset).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exposes a global `logger` defined AFTER the route handlers reference it (logger is created at module bottom). Currently works because handlers only access `logger` at call time after import, but this is fragile — move logging.basicConfig + logger definition to the top of the file (right after imports).
/api/identify/photo persists history but never exposes a GET endpoint to retrieve it; if not used elsewhere consider removing the write to reduce write load, or add a /api/history endpoint.

OWL_SYSTEM_PROMPT concatenates raw history into the system message AND emergentintegrations LlmChat already manages session-scoped context; this double-records context. Functionally fine (multi-turn test passed) but slightly redundant — consider relying on LlmChat session memory only.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is technically an invalid combo per spec; browsers may reject. Either pin origins or set allow_credentials=False.
seed_data_creation: No DB seed created. Test downloaded a real Northern Cardinal JPEG from Unsplash to /tmp/cardinal.jpg for vision testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests hit the public URL (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://birdscan-pro.preview.emergentagent.com). Note: frontend/.env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL); conftest.py handles both. The vision test takes ~5-10s on GPT-4o. xeno-canto is expected to return empty recordings until XENO_CANTO_KEY is added.
